[LLEX.10.6.1] **A synthetic name is `$` followed by the name.** Every name the compiler or the engine makes for itself is
spelt this way: a rule, schema or binding the compiler generates ([RLOW.9.1]),
an engine-internal fact (`$ClockTick`, [IRET.19.5]) and a fault's rule name
([LERR.9.11]). `$` is not a `NAME` character ([LLEX.10]), so no author name
equals a synthetic one and no source text writes one: a synthetic name has no
surface form. An author may declare any `NAME`, `__Foo__` included.
